description.value:
This crooked staff is made from twisting acacia wood and has a sphere of rough sandstone embedded in the top, to channel the magic of the desert. When wielding this staff in deserts, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to Subsist, Track, and Cover Tracks.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from the staff's list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Know the Way]

  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Create Water], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Vanishing Tracks]

  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Create Food], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Environmental Endurance]

  • 3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Cleanse Affliction], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Wall of Wind]

  • 4th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Fire Shield]

  • 5th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Elemental Form] (air or fire only)

  • 6th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Elemental Form] (air or fire only), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Petrify]

  • 7th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Fiery Body]

  • 8th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Desiccate], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Migration]

  • 9th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Wrathful Storm]

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed levels of all listed spells
